text.description_html:
DoralLock PRCLR, Chapelton Solid Brass Lever

Made out of solid brass, the Chapelton Door Lever has a unique shape that is totally now. A beautiful mixture of classic and modern design elements, the Chapelton Lever is sure to look great in almost any home. It is a part of today's most popular decorating trends, but that does not mean that it will soon outlive its appeal. This Port Royal Series door lever is sure to be a beautiful part of your home's unique style for years to come. It is easy to install, it is made for doors 1-3/8 inches to 2 inches thick with and adjustable backset from 2-3/8 inches to 2-3/4 inches.

Features of the DoralLock Chapelton Door Lever:

  • Easy to install, this lever fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • Comes packaged with a mortise latch.
  • Concealed screw mounting
  • 3-year mechanical warranty and a 1-year finish warranty.

Specifications of the Traditional DoralLock Made Lever:

  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/2"
  • Spindle Length: 3-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • DoralLock PRCLR Chapelton Lever Specifications (PDF)

When selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: A surfaced mounted, non-working, smooth lever. Non-locking and non-latching trim for one side of door. This inactive pull is usually used to match trim. Complete Set - 1 lever and 1 rose.
  • Passage (hall or closet): Latches but does not lock. The latch is activated by turning the either of the two levers. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch and strike plate
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): Latches and can be locked. Can be locked from the inside with a privacy pin located on the rose. In an emergency, it can unlocked via emergency release hole on exterior rose. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy pin, door latch and strike plate.
  • The Privacy Lever Function is Handed. Click Here to Determine Handing. All other lever functions are Non-Handed.
